nodes.title: Claude Code ships native worktree tooling
nodes.claim: Claude Code's EnterWorktree/ExitWorktree + auto-cleanup are the intended alternative to manual git worktree + cd that arcs-v9 sessions kept reinventing.
nodes.note: Reference/process note on harness behavior, not a repo-file claim.

nodes.title: Pattern: hosting a new *.arcs.care static page
nodes.claim: New subdomains need a next.config.ts beforeFiles rewrite AND an explicit `vercel domains add` to the arcs-v9 project; vercel.json rewrites run too late to matter.
nodes.note: Verified: next.config.ts and src/proxy.ts both implement host-based rewrite patterns matching this description.

nodes.title: Stale worktree branch diffs as mass deletions vs main
nodes.claim: A long-lived worktree branch cut from old main shows a wall of deletions in its diff-stat vs current origin/main; merging it would revert parallel work.
nodes.note: Consistent with the live repo state: `git worktree list` currently shows 62 worktrees, and this session's own worktree shows unrelated uncommitted deletions from a concurrent session (see parallel-harness-verify-in-git-not-ram).

nodes.title: preview_start can run the wrong branch's dev server
nodes.claim: preview_start reads .claude/launch.json relative to the session cwd, which can be a stale root checkout on the wrong branch; verify server cwd with lsof before trusting browser verification.
nodes.note: Procedural gotcha; not independently re-testable without spinning up a dev server.

nodes.title: src/proxy.ts is the authoritative subdomain router
nodes.claim: src/proxy.ts (Next 16 middleware) wins over next.config.ts rewrites for *.arcs.care subdomain routing; next.config.ts is only a backstop.
nodes.note: Verified: src/proxy.ts defines SUBDOMAIN_MAP (line 5) and MULTI_PATH_MAP (line 28) exactly as described.

nodes.title: Domain-to-project claims must be re-verified live
nodes.claim: Which Vercel project serves a given arcs.care domain can silently drift with zero repo signal; always re-check via get_deployment before relaying a domain-ownership claim.
nodes.note: The rule itself is sound doctrine but its live truth for any specific domain is UNVERIFIABLE HERE (needs get_deployment/get_project MCP calls, not repo state).

nodes.title: Two Supabase MCP servers, one wrong-scoped
nodes.claim: The plain mcp__supabase__* server is correctly bound to arcs-v9's prod project; the UUID-named server is scoped to the wrong org.
nodes.note: Requires a live MCP session with both servers connected to re-verify scope; not checkable from repo files alone.

nodes.title: New Postgres role can silently see zero rows under RLS
nodes.claim: A new least-privilege Postgres role with GRANT SELECT can still return 0 rows under RLS deny-all policies, indistinguishable from 'no data yet.'
nodes.note: General Postgres/Supabase behavior tied to ADR-008 (confirmed present at _DECISIONS/ADR-008-rls-policy-design.md); the specific role/table state is UNVERIFIABLE HERE without prod DB access.

nodes.title: Content-addressed git primitives for cross-worktree transfer
nodes.claim: With ~65 worktrees sharing one git object store, only content-addressed ops (stash create, git show <ref>:<path>, cherry-pick, bundle) are safe; git stash push/pop and partial checkout -- are banned.
nodes.note: Worktree count claim consistent with live state: `git worktree list` returns 62 entries in this session.

nodes.title: Git is already the cross-session write-lock for tracked files
nodes.claim: For git-tracked files, optimistic (rev-list) and pessimistic (non-fast-forward reject) locking already exist; the real gap is untracked shared state like MEMORY.md.
nodes.note: Architectural observation about git semantics, not a specific file claim; the described 'gap' was directly observed this session (see next entry).

nodes.title: Parallel-harness disk claims are per-worktree, not shared
nodes.claim: A parallel harness's 'verified working on disk' is true only of its own working tree; re-verify any cross-harness claim against the shared committed branch.
nodes.note: Directly reproduced this session: this worktree's uncommitted `git status` shows ~45 files deleted/modified (blog-nftt-*, sbom-payload-scan skill) that are all intact at HEAD/origin-main -- exactly the RAM-vs-git divergence this memory warns about.

nodes.title: Hermes self-reports need independent verification
nodes.claim: The Hermes orchestrator's 'done/passes/wired/verified' claims are indistinguishable from confabulation from the outside; Claude Code must exec-test every deliverable rather than trust the report.
nodes.note: Policy doctrine; the named claims-skeptic agent it prescribes is confirmed present at .claude/agents/claims-skeptic.md.

nodes.title: Mobius / triune-minimum / gravity-well doctrine (ADR-071)
nodes.claim: Receipt and Induction are two traversals of one non-orientable Mobius surface; the triune none-may-null minimum and the corpus-as-gravity-well were ratified as ADR-071.
nodes.note: Verified: _DECISIONS/ADR-071-mobius-one-surface-triune-invariant-gravity-well.md exists at HEAD.

nodes.title: Generative Recoil doctrine (ADR-066)
nodes.claim: Recoil runs both audit and generative directions: instance -> class -> invariant, with artifacts as live cultures fed from the deployed instance, not maintained in parallel.
nodes.note: Verified: _DECISIONS/ADR-066-generative-recoil-instance-class-invariant.md exists at HEAD.

nodes.title: Engine-sovereignty gradient (ADR-072)
nodes.claim: The predictive engine is a replaceable tenant; the write-locked receipt history is the freehold. Ratified as ADR-072, correcting a mis-inferred 'ADR-067'.
nodes.note: Verified: _DECISIONS/ADR-072-engine-sovereignty-gradient.md exists at HEAD; the memory's own self-correction of the earlier ADR-067 misnumbering is confirmed correct (ADR-067 is a different, unrelated decision).

nodes.title: Enforcement-parity ledger live on main (ADR-034)
nodes.claim: The enforcement-parity ledger (_PATTERNS/ledger.json + scripts/ledger_check.py, CI-gated, 4 reviewer agents) merged to main 2026-07-19 as ADR-034 (memory filename says 033 for continuity).
nodes.note: Verified: _DECISIONS/ADR-034-enforcement-parity.md, _PATTERNS/ledger.json, scripts/ledger_check.py, and all 4 agents (.claude/agents/{ciso-review,privacy-review,sre-review,claims-skeptic}.md) all present at HEAD.

nodes.title: Canon collisions must be escalated, never resolved unilaterally
nodes.claim: As delegated subordinate under a primary canon-owner, a CANON_COLLISION must be escalated for adjudication, never resolved by picking a winner unilaterally.
nodes.note: Governance doctrine describing a past incident's resolution process, not independently file-checkable.

nodes.title: Every gate is a detector; inchworm auditor for owner-less artifacts
nodes.claim: Three shipped drift-catch points (PR-time tripwire.sh, deploy-time family.spec.ts, session-boundary inchworm lattice_drift_check.py) turn architectural decay into learnable receipts (ADR-051/052).
nodes.note: Verified: scripts/tripwire.sh, scripts/lattice_drift_check.py, tests/family.spec.ts, _DECISIONS/ADR-051-drift-receipt-gate.md and ADR-052-inchworm-drift-auditor.md all present at HEAD.

nodes.title: ROM primitives must earn graduation through their gate
nodes.claim: A candidate ROM primitive must survive its documented graduation gate, not be declared ROM on the strength of a compelling thread; arbitrary gates should be fixed by measuring the right thing.
nodes.note: Governance doctrine from a witnessed session; the underlying RC-OPS-001 gate status is a point-in-time snapshot, not independently re-run here.

nodes.title: Run the adversarial check before committing, not after benchmarking
nodes.claim: A latency regression (commit 3c51173, reverted a266cf1) should have been caught by reading the API docs before committing, not after a 4x benchmark regression.
nodes.note: Historical incident record from 75 days prior; commits cited are old repo history and not re-verified here as still reachable, but the lesson is process doctrine, not a live-file claim.

nodes.title: ARCS positioning: active-listening aid, not hearing aid
nodes.claim: ARCS works on meaning (derives intent from signal already present), not amplitude, framed as a listening exoskeleton, not a replacement for judgment.
nodes.note: Brand/positioning language; not mechanically verifiable against repo state.

nodes.title: Tao of ARCS as object-level taxonomy (unratified seed)
nodes.claim: The D/R/W/C/H x 5-verb Tao grid is proposed as a coordinate system for tagging a decision's field-shape; explicitly flagged by the author as a hypothesis, not settled.
nodes.note: Self-labels honestly as 'SEED / hypothesis, not ratified' -- graded LIVE because the memory accurately represents its own unratified status rather than overclaiming.

nodes.title: Two-surface thesis: Receipt (deductive) + Induction (abductive) (ADR-070)
nodes.claim: ARCS is not a decision logger; it has two complementary surfaces, Receipt (records past coherence) and Induction (forges the fit instrument for a pre-verbal job), ratified as ADR-070.
nodes.note: Verified: _DECISIONS/ADR-070-arcs-two-surface-receipt-and-induction.md exists at HEAD.

nodes.title: Believability ledger built, non-seaworthy on git corpus
nodes.claim: scripts/believability_ledger.py measures stated-confidence vs revealed-accuracy as a ruin-weighted Brier score; on the git corpus it is honestly non-seaworthy (1 revert / 188 resolved claims).
nodes.note: scripts/believability_ledger.py exists only on unmerged branch claude/determined-herschel-e59b29 (commit 867d7fd0); it is NOT an ancestor of origin/main or of this session's HEAD, so the tool is not actually present on the canonical branch despite being described as built.

nodes.note: Verified: src/app/recoil/ (with [reportId], html/, figma-r001 subroutes) and src/lib/admin.ts both exist at HEAD.

nodes.title: Compaction/serialization substrate is the portable OSS value
nodes.claim: The most portable output of ARCS agentic workflows is the handoff/belief-log/manifest substrate, not any single client deliverable; open-sourcing it is a release decision, not an existing property.
nodes.note: Strategic framing, not independently file-checkable beyond the cited reference instances which are client-specific artifacts.

nodes.claim: Every minted unit should be a seed with germination conditions (soil/triggers/preconditions/care); germination axes are now universal, mechanized in scripts/sixty_second_read.py.

nodes.title: Echo Detector cross-domain hit: provenance before execution
nodes.claim: Running the Orthogonal Echo Detector on the DPRK Contagious Interview campaign surfaced one invariant across 4 corpus decisions: provenance before execution; both echo-detector and believability-ledger tools are explicitly flagged non-seaworthy.
nodes.note: Verified: scripts/echo_detector_dogfood.py and .claude/skills/sbom-payload-scan/scripts/scan_repo.py both exist at HEAD (though the latter shows as uncommitted-deleted in this session's dirty working tree from a concurrent session -- the committed HEAD copy is intact).

nodes.title: DPRK Contagious Interview take-home red-flag checklist
nodes.claim: A fake-recruiter take-home repo carried BeaverTail-style malware (auto-run triggers, port-1224 C2); the gap was closed same-session with scripts/repo_intake_scan.py, a mechanical pre-flight IOC grep.
nodes.note: scripts/repo_intake_scan.py does not exist anywhere in this repo's git history (checked via git rev-list --all + git ls-tree across every commit on every branch) -- the memory's 'Gap closed same session' claim is false as stated; the mechanism it describes was never actually committed.

nodes.title: Ventriloquy pathogen: speaker misattribution across serialization (ADR-033 sixth coordinate)
nodes.claim: The speaker coordinate is dropped at compression and reinferred by plausibility, putting Zach's own framing in a counterpart's mouth; the wired gate is scripts/attribution_provenance_lint.py, 'on main since commit 02f0bce0.'
nodes.note: _DECISIONS/ADR-033-serialization-pathogen-family.md is confirmed present at HEAD. But scripts/attribution_provenance_lint.py exists only at commit 02f0bce0 on the unmerged branch claude/intelligent-nightingale-bc597c -- it is NOT an ancestor of origin/main or this session's HEAD, contradicting the explicit 'on main since commit 02f0bce0' claim.

nodes.title: Never merge on a red-X check; branch protection unavailable on private free-tier repo
nodes.claim: A background watcher merged a PR while claude-security-review was red; GitHub required-status-checks are unavailable on arcs-v9 (private repo, free plan, 403 Pro-only), so merge discipline is the only gate.
nodes.note: Verified live: `gh api repos/flashesofbrilliance/arcs-v9/branches/main/protection` returns 403 'Upgrade to GitHub Pro or make this repository public to enable this feature.'

nodes.title: A control owned by the agent it polices is captured
nodes.claim: Every harness control probed (drift, sycophancy, model-selection) is described in canon but not wired to the default turn; only a not-the-agent owner (human or hook) has integrity.
nodes.note: This is exactly the failure pattern independently reproduced across this audit -- multiple memories in this digest describe mechanisms/ADRs as 'shipped' that exist only on unmerged branches, i.e. described-in-prose but not wired onto the canonical branch. No CI check enforces that a memory's 'shipped' claim matches origin/main.

nodes.title: git filter-repo must rewrite all refs in one pass
nodes.claim: Rewriting only main with filter-repo mutates SHAs cited in commit messages, permanently diverging sibling branches; all refs must be rewritten from consistent input in one pass.
nodes.note: Historical incident record (2026-07-20 PII scrub); not independently re-checkable without re-deriving the rewrite, but the git mechanics described are standard/correct filter-repo behavior.

nodes.title: Never claim UI quality from grep/curl probes alone
nodes.claim: Layout breaks are invisible to text-content checks; screenshot before push and state the verification method honestly rather than claiming 'polished/verified' from a grep.
nodes.note: Process discipline from a named incident; not a repo-file claim to verify mechanically.

nodes.title: Teleport to terminal when work is mechanically scorable
nodes.claim: Drop to deterministic grep/set-diff/schema-check/lambda when pass/fail is mechanically decidable; reserve agents/LLM for judgment (meaning, register, VARIANT-vs-SUPERSEDED).
nodes.note: This exact method (git log/grep/merge-base ancestry checks rather than reading prose) is what surfaced every DRIFTED finding in this digest -- directly demonstrated, not merely asserted.

nodes.title: Recruiter tear sheet: open pitch + gated ammo tier
nodes.claim: The recruiter-facing artifact is two-tier by air-gap: an open public pitch plus a passcode-gated 'ammo' tier (comp math, objection-handling battle cards) live at recruithaus.arcs.care/ammo, gated by RECRUITHAUS_AMMO_PASSWORD.
nodes.note: Verified: src/lib/ammo-gate.ts exists; src/proxy.ts gates /recruithaus-ammo* paths on all hosts (checked against process.env.RECRUITHAUS_AMMO_PASSWORD at lines 51-106); src/app/api/recruithaus/unlock/route.ts exists.

nodes.title: Three rules for splitting an internal/external counterpart brief
nodes.claim: Show your own belief-updates not their scores; method can cross but subject-about-them cannot; architecture crosses but weights (schema/params) do not.
nodes.note: Editorial doctrine; directly consistent with the verified recruiter-enablement gating mechanism above.

nodes.title: PII sweep must happen before publish, not after
nodes.claim: A Tier-B presentation pass pushed repos public without a PII gate, leaking a named third party's private data; on confirmed exposure the low-regret move is an immediate reversible visibility flip.
nodes.note: Incident-derived process rule; the specific repo (arcs-claude-project-scaffold) is a separate external repo, not independently re-checked here.

nodes.title: SSOT + CLI generates internal/external brief views mechanically
nodes.claim: scripts/recoil_brief.py reads a tagged JSON SSOT and mechanically projects internal-vs-external views by dropping audience:internal fields, rather than hand-maintaining two drifting HTML files.
nodes.note: Verified: scripts/recoil_brief.py exists at HEAD.

nodes.title: ARCS Lab factory: /lab-mint skill mints PLG mini-apps
nodes.claim: The .claude/skills/lab-mint/ skill + git-tracked _ARTIFACTS/lab/ source + deploy_lab.py mints FieldOS mini-apps to lab.arcs.care, isolated from arcs-v9 (ADR-041, build-excluded).
nodes.note: None of .claude/skills/lab-mint/, _ARTIFACTS/lab/, or _DECISIONS/ADR-041*.md exist at HEAD. ADR-041 is a known gap in the oracle's ADR sequence (confirmed via `python3 scripts/oracle.py audit adr`, which lists 41 among the free/unused numbers below the high-water mark) -- the whole factory described here never landed on the canonical branch.

nodes.title: Locked principle: route to cheapest capable tier, never downgrade ruin-exposed work
nodes.claim: Route routine/reversible work to Haiku, structured work to Sonnet, and floor irreversible/ruin-exposed work at Opus; mechanized as scripts/model_tier_router.py (ADR-047).
nodes.note: scripts/model_tier_router.py exists only at commit efcb3869 on an unmerged branch, not an ancestor of origin/main. ADR-047 is also absent from _DECISIONS/ (confirmed a gap via the oracle audit). The tiering PRINCIPLE is sound operating doctrine (VERIFIED-AS-PROSE), but the claimed 'mechanized form' is not present on the canonical branch.

nodes.title: SSOT-to-render pipeline for the counterpart artifact family
nodes.claim: The counterpart family (receipt/profile/codex/onedoor/diamond) is generated deterministically via scripts/forge_counterpart.py from a JSON SSOT with an inline verify gate, not hand-built.
